title: 抽象情绪 MV
summary: 将情绪转折映射为物件、空间和身体姿态的变化，先锁定抽象人物的视觉规则。
constraints: Choose recurring visual motifs before generating shots.
Use an explicit face policy; faceless characters are a creative choice, not a universal default.
Preserve supplied lyric timing unless evidence supports a scoped correction.
Abstract style still requires intentional progression across musical sections.
